'''''Revenge of the Sith''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that portrayed the faces of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Anakin Skywalker, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Masters [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]],<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> and two [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptors]]<ref name="SV-ROTS">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050811a|text=Starships and Vehicles of ''Revenge of the Sith''}}</ref> were also depicted in the painting. A [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|lightsaber duel]] between Skywalker and Kenobi was depicted in the center foreground.<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="ROTS" />

One of many paintings, ''Revenge of the Sith'' was most prevalent during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The painting appeared sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="SWG" /> which took place in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> and was a pivotal conflict in the war.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Revenge of the Sith'' appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. It was a reward from the "Buddy Token" system. Players who invited others to play ''Star Wars Galaxies'' were awarded these Buddy Tokens once the people they had invited purchased the game and a subscription. One token was rewarded for each person they invited. The inviting player could then redeem the tokens for this painting and other rewards, including two [[The Phantom Menace (painting)|other]] [[Attack of the Clones (painting)|paintings]] and a [[Light Bending BARC Speeder]]. The painting required three Buddy Token to acquire. It could be used in one of the player's personal structures as decoration. The painting is actually a cropped version of the theatrical poster for [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], and, since it depicts an [[In-universe|out-of-universe]] image, its [[canon]] status is ambiguous.<ref name="SWG" />
